A MAP WITH SOURCES

About the data.

584profiles captured251verified cross-links29BU headline ties

Captured from your signed-in LinkedIn connection list on November 16, 2026. The list reports 603 connections but returns 584 profile rows at its end. The remaining 19 profiles are unavailable in this snapshot; no placeholders were invented.

Facts and estimates

Names, headlines and connection dates come from LinkedIn. Categories overlap. Each captured headline and available organization field was reviewed for category evidence; a person can belong to several categories. Counts therefore sum above 584. Categories, industry fit, function fit and seniority are estimates from captured details; no live-profile verification is implied. General design and insufficient-detail cases retain explicit uncertainty in the data. A student’s “senior” year is not treated as a senior job level. Recruiting headlines may describe vacancies rather than the recruiter’s own title.

BU ties ≠ confirmed alumni

29 headlines mention BU; only 2 explicitly indicate alumni status. Students and faculty are marked as BU ties. Other alumni status is unknown until you confirm it.

A partial map of mutual connections

Solid lines connect you to your captured contacts. Dashed lines show verified connections between two of those contacts; they do not indicate second- or third-degree LinkedIn connections. Hover a name or dot to highlight it in yellow. Click to keep that person and their verified paths highlighted until you select another person or close the panel. Yellow becomes more muted along further verified contact-to-contact links.

251 unique cross-links were observed in mutual-result pages for James Grady, Nicholas Rock, Clif Stoltze, Frank Paterno, Erin Kelly and Sheryl Peng, plus Adam Kelley’s visible mutual connection. These are real observed links, not an exhaustive network. Shared employers and schools alone never create a line.

Organization size & opportunities

Company sizes were checked for Trivium Interactive, Stoltze Design Group and Workshop/APD. Others remain unknown. “Hiring” in a headline is a signal to investigate, not a verified open job. Add your own confirmed context in a person’s card.

Adjacent discovery clouds

Only observed second-degree people outside your captured direct network can appear in an adjacent cloud. Their relevance must be strictly above 60 under your current weights. Sources are attached to the visible relationship links. Extended-network coverage is loading. Hover a direct contact to fade in a compact adjacent preview without moving the camera; move away to fade it out, or click to pin it and frame both clouds. Hidden or unchecked networks remain unknown; an empty cloud does not prove there are no relevant people.
